translations.web: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.asv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
